name: [Master][Logika] Trial balance debit and credit totals are equal
description: The trial balance for the current month must balance to the rupiah.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the trial balance report (Neraca Saldo) from the reports menu
Filter the period to the first and last day of the current month
Verify the footer total debit equals the footer total credit exactly and no imbalance warning is shown

name: [Master][Logika][SR-01] Net sales card excludes returned sales and tempo is not labeled QRIS
description: The sales report card named net sales must subtract returns, and credit (tempo) sales must not be counted in the QRIS/transfer card.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the sales return history and note the date of the newest return and its amount
Open the sales report and filter it to that single date

Verify the net sales card (Total Penjualan Bersih) equals the sum of the listed receipt totals minus the returns of that date, and any tempo receipts listed are not counted in the non-cash QRIS/transfer card

name: [Master][Logika][RPT-01] Inventory variance account is classified the same in income statement and balance sheet
description: Account 5120 (Beban Selisih Persediaan) must sit in the same bucket in both reports so gross profit agrees.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the income statement for the current year and note gross profit and whether account 5120 is listed under cost of goods sold or operating expenses
Open the balance sheet as of today and expand the current-period profit detail
Verify account 5120 is in the same category (cost of goods sold or operating expense) on both reports
